source: FLUX.3 [klein] evaluation set, disjoint from the calibration prompts: short and detailed text-to-image prompts, edits on references generated by the BF16 model, and the six Qwen Image 2.1 blog-fidelity edit inputs used by the other lite-infer comparisons.

text_to_image.prompt: A watercolor painting of a small lighthouse on a rocky island beneath a cloudy lavender sky.
A candid portrait of a woman with silver hair in a blue wool sweater beside a large window, soft morning light, realistic skin texture and natural colors.
A red fox curled up asleep beneath a snow-covered pine tree, fine fur, winter morning, wildlife photography.
A ceramic bowl of ramen with an egg, mushrooms and scallions on a dark wooden counter, warm steam, food photography.

A minimalist concert poster with a large orange circle over a deep blue background. Bold white condensed text at the top reads "MIDNIGHT ECHOES" and smaller text at the bottom reads "Live at the Harbor Hall - June 21". Grainy risograph print texture.

A narrow street in an old Mediterranean town with pale stone walls, climbing bougainvillea, blue wooden doors and a sleeping cat on a doorstep. Afternoon sunlight casts long shadows across the cobblestones, and laundry hangs between the balconies above. Warm, nostalgic travel photography.

A friendly retro robot made of brushed aluminium with round glowing blue eyes, watering potted plants on a sunny apartment balcony. Terracotta pots with tomatoes and basil, a city skyline in the background, soft cinematic lighting, highly detailed 3D render.

A professional kitchen during dinner service: a female chef with tattooed forearms and a black apron plates a dish with tweezers under bright heat lamps, while cooks move behind her in a blur of motion and flames rise from a pan. Documentary photography, high contrast, shallow depth of field.

A chalkboard cafe menu hanging on a brick wall, hand-lettered in white and yellow chalk. The title reads "Today's Specials" and the items read "Espresso 3.00", "Flat White 4.50", "Matcha Latte 5.00" and "Lemon Cake 4.00", with small chalk drawings of a coffee cup and a leaf.

An anime-style illustration of a schoolgirl with short teal hair standing on a rooftop at sunset, her uniform and hair blowing in the wind, the city below glowing with warm lights and a train crossing a distant bridge. Vibrant colors, detailed background, cel shading.

generated_reference_edits.prompt: Change his white shirt to a brown leather jacket over a black turtleneck, keeping his face and the park background the same.

generated_reference_edits.reference_prompt: A small cafe entrance with a blank wooden sign above the door, daytime street photo.

generated_reference_edits.reference_prompt: A red barn next to a green field and a single oak tree under a blue summer sky.
generated_reference_edits.prompt: Turn the scene into autumn with orange and red leaves on the oak tree, golden fields and a misty morning sky.
